title: Chapter 326
text:
Learning … 15% … 74% …

Successfully learned! You have learned [Advanced Detection Technology]!

As the new knowledge was imprinted in his mind, his Potential Points jumped and decreased by 2 points to 55 points.

Using Potential Points to learn and level up Knowledges did not seem like much, as learning all 15 Advanced Knowledges only required 30 Potential Points. However, if one were to include the cost of leveling up, the Potential Points would never be enough. In the later stages, Potential Points would become more and more precious. In his previous life, Han Xiao had no choice but to reset his Potential Points, so he was very cautious when dealing with Knowledges now.

Because of the limitation of Potential Points, Mechanic players could only choose to develop in different ways, each with their own unique characteristics. Other than the Potential Points gained from leveling up, a skill would also gain one Potential Point when it was maxed out. Therefore, players had ways to strengthen themselves after maxing out, to find new skills, and to continue earning EXP.

The Mechanic class would never lack skills. Every new blueprint was a new skill, and they only lacked EXP.

This was the basic blueprint that came with the knowledge.

Most players would feel that the detection technology was of little value. It had a longer field of vision, more multi-dimensional detection, and the analysis of spectral energy waves and so on. It could not directly increase one's combat strength. However, this was also a very important technology. As the level of combat became higher and higher, without over-the-horizon and multi-dimensional detection methods, one would be as good as blind. However, players preferred to buy the ready-made detection machines on the market. Therefore, only the large guilds' production teams and merchant players would learn this kind of supplementary knowledge to achieve a supply and demand relationship.

"Actually, this knowledge is not bad. It can satisfy my own needs, and I can sell the detection devices to the players generously. This kind of crucial supplementary equipment can be considered a necessity."

He now had three Advanced Knowledges, and he only needed two more to fulfill one of the requirements of the Class Advancement. Money was the biggest problem now. Han Xiao's goal was to make the players rich together, expand the market, and bring the players to earn money from other NPCs.

Han Xiao had the advantage of being familiar with the storyline. Although this period of time could barely be considered a blank period in his memory, there were still traces that he could follow. For example, some long-term employment missions were a good choice to earn the first pot of gold.

When he returned to the lounge, most of the people had obediently stayed behind. Han Xiao glanced around and found that Farewell Song and the Temple of God players were gone.

Han Xiao frowned. "Where did the others go?"

Pork Bun explained, "They said they're going out for a walk to familiarize themselves with the environment. They'll be back soon."

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

Bullsh * t, how could he not understand this group of people? It was just that they had come to a new environment full of opportunities, so they couldn't wait to get in touch with new people and trigger quests. That was why they had completely ignored his instructions.

Most of the players were mercenaries, and this was understandable, especially the professional players. However, if he couldn't even sit still for such a short period of time, it was obvious that he couldn't resist the temptation of the colorful world.

This was also a hidden danger that Han Xiao had thought of long ago. As good opportunities continued to appear, it would gradually dilute the thoughts of these players following him. They would start to become restless and want to join more profitable factions.

To ensure that the players would follow him firmly, Han Xiao had already prepared a plan in advance. Now was the time to implement it.

"Follow me. It's time to work."

Han Xiao turned around and walked out the door. The players followed behind him.

The group came to a large building. Inside was a square like hall. Various races were either sitting or standing, coming and going, chatting with each other. They all had one thing in common — these people were all wearing combat equipment. Basically, they were all Supers.

"What is this place?" The players looked around.

Han Xiao slowly said, "The Universe Mercenary Alliance is an authoritative neutral mercenary organization. Its business covers the entire Galaxy and is jointly led and established by the three Universal Civilizations. It is absolutely neutral, and any intelligent creature can register as a mercenary. The Mercenary Alliance classifies the registered mercenaries and connects them with the mercenaries of various difficulty missions. It coordinates supply and demand, allocates human resources, and provides convenience for both parties. The Mercenary Alliance has a very long history, and it is absolutely neutral like the Universe Bank. It protects the rights of both employers and mercenaries and does not force the mercenaries to do anything. It is just a supply and demand platform. "

He also knew that the Mercenary Alliance's original intention was to give Supers something to do. They could use their own abilities to earn money and let Supers vent their energy so that they would not cause trouble everywhere. As the saying went, martial artists used martial arts to break the law. Supers were strong individually and were a threat to public security. The Mercenary Alliance's effect was very obvious. Not only did it give Supers a free job, but it also indirectly maintained the stability of the region. Both parties benefited from each other.

However, there was no need to tell this to the players.

The players suddenly understood. All of a sudden, the eyes of the professional players lit up. They had come to the galaxy for the intergalactic mission rewards, and they could not wait to register immediately. However, seeing that Han Xiao did not say anything, they held back for the time being.

Metal balls the size of a fist floated in the hall. When a mercenary waved his hand, the ball would automatically fly over. Then, the center of the ball would crack open and light up, forming a virtual screen. This was an automated terminal that allowed the mercenaries to do their own business.

Han Xiao took a small ball and turned on the operation screen.

"Please enter your mercenary account and login," the ball said in a mechanical voice.

Han Xiao clicked on the registration button. The screen changed, and it prompted him to enter his identity and connect to his bank account.

Han Xiao entered his bank account. The screen flashed, and his identity information was displayed. There was only a basic name, and there was only one resume below it — Defending Short Horn Star. The resume was the deeds left behind in the universe. It was like an activity diary. He had just entered the galaxy, so it was like a blank piece of paper.

These deeds were actually the performance of the popularity value on the interface. However, some deeds without witnesses might not be recorded in the resume. However, the popularity system on the interface was different. Even if there were no witnesses, as long as the rumors spread, the value would increase and the 'fame' would be digitized.

Mercenaries needed a codename. Han Xiao's nickname in Blue Star was' Black Phantom ', which did not seem to be very impressive. Han Xiao decided to change to a new codename to increase the freshness of the players.

After thinking about it, Han Xiao said slowly.

"Then I'll be called … Black Star."

Black Phantom was a nickname used by assassins, and it gave people the feeling that it was a little dark and limited. However, the new codename gave off a very 'proper' vibe, and it matched his image very well. The Great Mechanic Han was very satisfied.

It was another codename that started with 'black.' He had a special liking for this color. In his previous life, he had liked to wear black, not because he was handsome, but because it could not be seen when it was dirty. It could numb him and prevent him from washing his clothes.

After entering a bunch of information, the ball extended a probe and said, "If you are a Super, please release your energy on the probe. The system will analyze your grade, which will affect the difficulty of the mission assigned to you."

Holding the probe, Han Xiaoxin thought about it, and electric sparks exploded on his fingertips. He used eighty percent of his strength, and the screen showed that he was grade C.

"Data collection complete. Creating file …"

—

Mercenary Code: Black Star

Credibility Points: 10 (Basic Points)

Strength Level: C

Profession: Mechanic

Certificate Badge: None

Team Affiliation: None

Overall Evaluation: New Mercenary

—
